intro.fr: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth a eu son randomizer d'ennemis et de compétences un mois après sa sortie.
intro.en: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth got its enemy and skill randomizer a month after its release.

text.fr: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio sort Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth en 2024.
text.en: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio releases Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth in 2024.

text.fr: Le 17 février 2024, Zoo, déjà auteur du randomizer de Yakuza: Like a Dragon, publie sur Nexus Mods celui d'Infinite Wealth, qui randomise ennemis et compétences.
text.en: On February 17, 2024, Zoo, already the author of the Yakuza: Like a Dragon randomizer, posts the Infinite Wealth one on Nexus Mods, which randomizes enemies and skills.
